clips.title: The story
paras: Hunters seek Isha Awak’s heart along the Merchant Coast south of Ratchet. Mahren Skyseer wants it as proof that the Deep Doom has been overcome.

Isha Awak prowls the sea off the Merchant Coast, south of Ratchet. Sailors and coastal folk revere and fear the massive thresher, known as the Deep Doom. It has killed many human trespassers along the shore. Mahren Skyseer, a tauren mystic, sees an honorable predator, not a mindless menace. She believes its fierce spirit dwells in its heart. Mahren charges brave hunters to plunge into the waves, defeat Isha Awak in its own domain, and claim the heart as both trophy and spiritual offering.
